project.name: Vidulum Market
project.description:
The outside world: what things are worth and which venues the owner is connected to.
An aggregator, not a parent - every module below still inherits from the root pom, so moving a module in or out of this folder changes no dependency and no artifactId. Build the group with `./mvnw test -f market/pom.xml`; that reactor does not contain vidulum-shared-kernel, so it resolves it from the local repository.
The boundary with wealth is one-way and checked: no module here imports anything from portfolio, trading, pnl or risk, while wealth reaches in through *-api only. Prices and venues know nothing about who owns what.
vidulum-okx lives here because it implements the SPI of both contracts in this folder - BrokerQuotationProvider from quotation-api and ExchangeAdapter from exchange-api - and compiles against nothing else. A second venue adapter belongs next to it.
